browser.label: Browser self-test
browser.scope: Rendered age gate, catalogue, product, cart, checkout, ten market modules and the 19-workspace Admin/TechOps simulation.

catalogue.label: Verified catalogue pipeline
catalogue.scope: Fixture ingestion, normalisation, coverage, validation and licensed-feed example handling.

accessories.label: Wine Accessories pipeline
accessories.scope: Accessory taxonomy, normalisation, validation rules, schema and append-only DDL contract.

africa.label: Africa Marketplace registry
africa.scope: Market registry, candidate brands, draft templates, workflows, schema, DDL and storefront snapshot source.

overlap.explanation: The browser suite asserts rendered DOM behaviour; the three offline suites run in Node against ingestion/registry artefacts. No suite invokes another and no assertion is counted in two suites. Shared product and Admin facts are separate checks at different layers, not combined totals.
